fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-05-07, a person claiming to be a recruitment agent took Rs. 2,50,000 from the complainant for a job offer that did not materialise. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-04-30 at roughly 13:50. The complaint was lodged by Inban Babu (9000000448). Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100006. Chandran Krishnan (9000000031) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A person named Vasanth Mani, associated with the number 9000000382, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A further person, Kavitha Sri, a relative of the suspect, using the number 9000000129, is stated to be associated with the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly issued a forged offer letter and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: job fraud, cheating, mobile number, suspect, residential colony, call detail, receiving account, associate
